comment: Court colour presets (ADR-022, kitchen ADR-027). Each part recolours entries of BG1 palette 2 (the ground). Index 0 is DEFAULT: the colours painted in court_scene.png. Other presets give a base colour; the generator derives the part's other entries by scaling it by the painted entries' brightness relative to the painted base.

kitchen.comment: ADR-027: SAME follows the surface's preset; the rest mirror the surface presets in order (checked), then extras.

times.comment: Night courts (ADR-045): the TIME row of the COURT page. DAY is the scene as painted. Other times scale each 5-bit channel (red, green, blue) of the venue's backdrop (BG1 palettes 3-7) and of the ground's dark entries by 'dark', and the ground's lit entries (the court under floodlights: surface, kitchen, lines, net) by 'lit'. 'ambience' names a venues.json ambience to play instead of the venue's own.
